decision_rule: A draw-prediction hypothesis SURVIVES only if (a) Holm-adjusted training p < 0.05 across all hypotheses below AND (b) the pre-specified one-sided holdout test (direction fixed from training) has Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 across all holdout tests. Nominal p-values are reported too. MC/permutation nulls: shuffle order within draw for order effects (exact conditional null), uniform 5-subsets for set-level effects, label permutation across draws for heterogeneity effects.
pick_rule: If no draw hypothesis survives: pick the 5-subset with the lowest predicted player popularity (P1 model refit on all data), excluding subsets that contain two consecutive numbers or form an arithmetic progression (patterns players over-pick). If a draw hypothesis survives, rank numbers by that model first and use popularity only to break ties.
